notes: Original SC TO-I with the Offer to Purchase and Letter of Transmittal (excerpt ends inside the Letter of Transmittal signature block). commencement_date is taken from the date of the Offer to Purchase (October 12, 2021, also the filing date); the excerpt does not state a separate commencement date. Earlier press releases dated August 20, 2021 and October 4, 2021 were previously filed on Schedule TO but are not in this excerpt. trigger_origin: the excerpt says only that the Board determined to commence the offer and that the Fund has no absolute commitment to further tender offers; no programme, activist or merger link is stated, so board_discretionary is a reading, not a quote. The cover page titles the class 'Common shares of beneficial interest' while Item 2(b) and the offer call it Common Stock (Maryland corporation); security_class is common either way. Shares outstanding 6,044,310 as of September 30, 2021; 302,216 is stated directly as the 5% Offer Amount. The offer is not conditioned on any minimum number of shares, so minimum_tender is excluded. 'other' in conditions also covers condition (2), a forced portfolio liquidation that would hurt NAV, and (4) the Board's fiduciary-duty determination could equally be read as board_discretion. None of the cover-page transaction-type boxes is shown as checked in the excerpt.
